comments.author: reviewer
comments.body:
Changes requested (round-1 artifact review of 8a60eef7 / client 56d8027):

1. Named open args still missing (brief 18 + design §3)
   - `Banking.open()` still takes no options and only calls `Bank.openNearest()` (banking.js untouched).
   - `Bank.openBooth` still documents and implements “Extra rs2b0t args (stand / boothName / op / log) are ignored” and only queues snapshot `nearest_booth` identity.
   - `OpenStand` booth arm in host-play still calls the local `open_booth` helper (Use-quickly at tile only) and ignores name/op (unchanged since e621be867).
   - Required: default no-arg path stays; supplied `stand` → walk-near radius 1 then open; supplied `boothName`/`boothOp` → named loc+op with no silent retarget; unsupported options (`obstacles`, `destination`, `preferNearby`, `nearbyRadius`, …) throw `not impl` with the option name. Cover with isolate/host tests that prove stand is not dropped and wrong name/op refuse.

2. Do not treat these as blocking this rework
   - Freshness + host-owned Withdraw-X look correct and independently verified below.
   - Evidence report/raw receipts: root is recovering `docs/compat/evidence/banking-capabilities/` + `04-capabilities-banking.md` from the implementer session; do not re-run suites solely for docs.
   - Handoff limit corrections: `world_boundary_live.rs` is committed source and needs `--features memory-profile` (not a missing scenario dep); `STAFF_RUNES` is an existing casting catalog gap, not concurrent catalog product WIP; external client repo/gitlink integration remains root-owned (root auditing 56d8027).

Verified independently (pass):
- `cargo test -p script --lib pending_withdraw_x_pause_freezes`
- `cargo test -p api bank_loaded_requires_current_component`
- `cargo test -p host-play --lib withdraw_x` (compose + expired dialog)
- `cargo test -p client --test gens inventory_packet_state_preserves|logout_clears_inventory`
- `cargo test -p client --test revision_289_stage2 revision_289_inventory_and_modal`
- `cargo test -p script --test load_isolate isolate_bank_withdraw_x|isolate_banking_open`
- `cargo test -p script --lib bank_loaded_uses_packet`
- `cargo test -p script --test gold_stubs withdraw_x`

Minimum outcome to re-request review: named open path + tests as in (1); keep Pause freeze / Stop-reconnect abort / monotonic 3000+4000 Withdraw-X / packet-fresh bank_loaded behavior intact.
